newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AWB Report - Confidence pool price will be met.
newsitem.headline: AWB Report - Confidence pool price will be met.

text.p: The Australian Wheat Board's (AWB) 1997/98 pool price reflects confidence that the price will be achieved, despite falling international wheat prices, the AWB said in its weekly report.
The AWB pool price for 1997/98 Australian Standard White (ASW) is currently estimated at A$190 to A$200 a tonne
"While it's still very early in the season, there have been good supporting rain in Western Australia and some light rain in South Australia and Victoria," the AWB said.
However, the rains were insufficient to increase sub soil moisture and generally more rain is required in coming weeks in the south eastern wheat-growing areas, the AWB said.
The AWB noted a fair level of activity at Australian ports this week, with wheat shipments to the Sudan, Abu Dhabi, Indonesia and Vietnam.
